title: The Neumann bounds at the displayed-expression gap are at most 27, 3938, and below 321 (no new κ)
body:
## Summary
- At `p=19`, `beta0=-1/2`, bandwidth 2, and `t_i=i`, keep survivor bandwidth `b=3` and set `rho` to the rational lower bound `L` for `exp(-9 pi/722)+5 exp(-18 pi)`. Every normalized off-sum on `0,1,2,7,8,9` is strictly below `L`, and `L<1-1/5776`.
- The lemma's right-hand sides at `delta=1-L` lie in `(26, 27]`, `(3937, 3938]`, and `(320, 321)`. They are smaller than the `delta=1/5776` bounds by factors in `[221, 222)`, `[50824, 50825)`, and `[11274122, 11274123)`.
- No new kappa is claimed. The selected record is unchanged. This applies the pinned lemma to one section; it does not prove the Neumann series.
